item.title_tr: Xiaomi Redmi Note 14 Pro 4G NFC 256GB | 512GB Global Version
item.description_tr:
We ship all over Brazil!

We work with 100% original products, sealed and in the global version!

Our stock is rotatable, the chargers can change, if you need it at the time of shipment people already put an adapter at no cost in the order!

Technical Specifications:

Processor
Helio G100-Ultra6nm manufacturing process
CPU: octa-core processor, up to 2.2 GHzGPU: Mali-G57 MC2

Storage and RAM
256GB + 8GB RAM

Screen
6.67" AMOLED screen Resolution: 2400 x 1080 Refresh rate: up to 120 Hz
Corning® Gorilla® Glass Victus® 2 sunlight displayReading mode

Rear camera
200 MP main camera
OISf/1.65Binning 16 in 1 in a large 2.24μm pixelSensor size 1/1.4”Lens 7P
8 MPf2.2 ultra-wide camera
2 MPf2.4 macro camera
Rear camera video recording 1080p at 60fps

Front Camera
32 MPf/2.2 front camera Front camera video recording 1080p at 30 fps

Battery and Charging
5500mAh (typical) 45W turbo charging
45W charger in box

AI Features
Google Gemini, IA image editing

Security
Screen Fingerprint Sensor Face Unlock by AI

Network and Connectivity
SIM 1 + Hybrid (SIM or microSD)
2G: GSM: 850 900 1800 1900 MHz
3G: WCDMA:1/2/4/5/8
4G: LTE FDD: 1/2/3/4/5/7/8/12/13/17/20/26/28/66
4G: LTE TDD:38/40/41
Bluetooth 5.3Protocolo Wi-Fi: 802.11a/b/g/n/ac

Water and dust resistance
IP64

Package Contents:
-Smartphone Redmi Note 14 Pro 4G
-Charger
-Protective cover
-Charging cable (Usb Type-C cable)
-chip ejector tool
-Manual
-Toast film
